# NOT Operator

The NOT operator `!` changes a Boolean value to the opposite value. Use `!` when your app needs to flip a state, such as turning something on or off.
name: NOT Operator
tips:
- Use `!` before a Boolean value or variable.
- `!true` becomes `false`, and `!false` becomes `true`.
- You can use `!` to toggle a value, like `isOn = !isOn;`.
- Be careful not to confuse `!` with comparison operators like `!==`.
- In Web Lab, `!` is often used to switch app states after a button click.
